title: Life Vision Worksheet
h1: Ask where you want to be in ten years and you get a blank. Describe an ordinary Tuesday and you get an answer.
sub: One full page for the Tuesday you want in ten years, four questions to work back from it, and one next step for this quarter.

uvp.p: A full page to describe the ordinary day you want: where you wake up, who is there, what the work is.
People, work, money, and what you will have stopped doing. Short answers, written in pencil.
You finish with the one thing you can do in the next three months that points the right way.

benefits.p: A specific day is easier to write than a ten-year goal, and easier to check against your week now.

benefits.h: What you will stop doing, on paper
benefits.p: One of the four questions asks what you will have stopped. It is often the clearest line on the page.
